messages:
jin (Docs): Quick heads-up  I opened a PR to clarify rate-limit headers and pricing tier examples on the quotas & billing page. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1492

ethan (Billing): Thanks. Can we make a clear table mapping header -> meaning (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset) and an example row for burst vs sustained? Customers keep confusing reset epoch vs seconds.

jin (Docs): Good call. I'll add a tiny example showing: `X-RateLimit-Reset: 1710000000` (epoch) and how to convert to human time in JS.

mae (SDK): I'll add a one-line snippet that shows reading the headers from the JS SDK response (node fetch style):
```js
const { headers } = await client.request(...);
const reset = Number(headers.get('x-ratelimit-reset'))*1000;
console.log(new Date(reset).toISOString());
```

zoe (Console): Also update the dashboard screenshots: the current screenshot uses `Quota` wording; Console now shows `Rate limit window` and `Metering window`. Need a replacement PNG from staging. I can grab a fresh one if docs want it.

jin (Docs): Please do. Also want to add a tiny migration note: older API used `quota_window_seconds` and now we expose `rate_window` and `meter_window`. Keep it non-technical: "If you stored epoch resets, continue to do so; rename fields for clarity."

ethan (Billing): Add a sentence about invoicing: "Reported meter units are used for usage invoices; rate-limit headers are advisory enforcement signals and may differ due to caching." Keeps expectations straight.

mae (SDK): Small nit: recommend adding an SDK snippet for Python too showing header parsing and a defensive `try/except` when header missing. I'll paste a 3-line snippet in the PR.

docs-bot: PR #1492 opened by jin 4C4 labels: docs, billing, needs-review

jin (Docs): I've included a short FAQ entry: "Why does my dashboard show fewer tokens than my app logs?" Answer: prefix caching, server-side dedup, and meter rounding. Will push in next commit. Aiming to merge early next week after screenshots and SDK snippets. Thanks all :thumbsup:
